capabilities: mark visited countries on an interactive world map
view totals and coverage percentage on a stats page
link countries to notes or travel logs
launch the map from the command palette
extras: Works on mobile (iOS and Android) and runs fully local without internet or external services.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually track visited countries on a map inside the vault.
summary: Interactive world map that lets you mark countries you have visited, with a stats page and optional links to travel notes.
